This text introduces a new, temporary newsletter from the Guardian newspaper called "Fighting Back." It was created to give people ideas on how to protect basic rights and freedoms during the Trump presidency. The article then gives advice for people who are concerned.

First, it suggests you take time to calm down and talk to people you trust. Once you are ready, you should write a personal goal focused on a single issue you care about. Next, think about all the groups that have power, from local and national government to big companies and community organizations. Finally, you should figure out how each of these groups is connected to the issue you want to work on.

Essentially, it is a guide for turning worry and concern into a focused plan for action.
